chaining: a free 200K-context text model and a free vision model are a zero-cost first pass in a two-stage pipeline; only the survivors go to a metered model

free_tier.stated: Two models are free on input, output and cache, with no token cap or expiry stated: the text model GLM-4.7-Flash (200K context) and the vision model GLM-4.6V-Flash. Concurrency per model is the only published constraint and the per-model figure sits behind a login
free_tier.notes: perpetual free models; the login page advertises a new-user experience pack of 20 million tokens (2000万); its model scope, expiry and any real-name condition are unverified: behind a…

limits.value: concurrency, the number of requests in flight at one moment, is capped per model and per user-rights tier (levels V0 to V3, raised by points that only cash-balance spending earns); the per-model figure for the free text model is on a login-gated page and is unverified

binding_note: concurrency per model and per user-rights tier; platform-level throttling can apply at peak load

identity_cost.detail: registration accepts a non-mainland phone number: choose the country code and verify by SMS code. The FAQ states API calls do not require real-name authentication (it is recommended for account security, and is the route to an enterprise account); whether the API-key page asks for it is unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: not assessed: no request was sent to the endpoint
confidence_note: the free-model list is the pricing page's own FAQ answer and the authentication FAQ says API calls do not require real-name authentication; the per-model concurrency figure and the terms of the new-user pack are unverified: behind a sign-up
